label: Every sentence the provider layer says

params.name: no_provider
params.default: No provider called {provider} does that kind of work.

params.name: no_kind
params.default: {kind} is not a kind of work a provider does (text, image, video).

params.name: no_model
params.default: {model} is not a model {provider} offers here - the list is chip providers.models.

params.name: no_key
params.default: No {provider} key on your account - add one in Account & key, or pick another provider there.

params.name: refused
params.default: The provider refused ({status}): {reason}

params.name: nothing_back
params.default: The provider answered with nothing usable.

params.name: timed_out
params.default: The provider did not finish within {secs}s.

params.name: needs_image
params.default: {model} makes video from a picture: approve a storyboard still for this shot first (or let the shot before it finish, so its last frame can lead).

params.name: all_keys_failed
params.default: Every {provider} key on your account failed - last one said: {reason}

params.name: key_exhausted
params.default: {name} hit its limit ({reason}); moving to the next key.

params.name: key_invalid
params.default: {name} was refused as invalid ({reason}); it will not be used until it passes a test.

params.name: no_such_key
params.default: No such key on your account.

params.name: too_many_keys
params.default: At most {max} keys per provider.

params.name: key_too_short
params.default: That does not look like a key.

params.name: key_ok
params.default: {name} works ({model}, {secs}s).

params.name: no_credit
params.default: Your {provider} account has run out of credit ({reason}).

params.name: key_no_credit
params.default: {name} has no credit left ({reason}); trying your next key.

params.name: model_gone
params.default: {provider} no longer offers the model "{model}" - it has been withdrawn. Nothing was charged. It is taken out of every model list; press the AI button again and pick another model.

params.name: check_failed
params.default: Could not ask {provider} for its models: {reason}

params.name: check_no_key
params.default: No key for {provider} - add one to check its models.

params.name: chip_refused
params.default: The change was not saved: the chip's own checks failed ({reason}).

params.name: model_exists
params.default: {model} is already in the list.

params.name: model_kind_bad
params.default: Pick what the model does: text, image or video.

params.name: keys_resting
params.default: Your {provider} key is resting after the provider said: {reason} - the portal tries it again in about {minutes} minutes, or add another key in Account & key.

params.name: model_swapped
params.default: {old} is no longer offered by {provider}; using {new} instead (same price or less).
params.label: model swapped

params.name: watch_subject
params.default: Models changed: {gone} gone, {new} new
params.label: watch subject

params.name: watch_text
params.label: watch text

params.name: watch_gone
params.default: - GONE {model} ({provider}){swap}
params.label: watch gone

params.name: watch_swap
params.default: -> everyone on it now uses {new}
params.label: watch swap

params.name: watch_noswap
params.default: -> no model at the same price or less; people on it must pick another
params.label: watch noswap

params.name: watch_new
params.default: - NEW {model} ({provider}, {kind})
params.label: watch new

params.name: watch_error
params.default: - could not ask {provider}: {reason}
params.label: watch error

description_nl: Every refusal and every failure the provider layer can say.
